summary: Petrobras furnished a Form 6-K disclosing board approval on September 18, 2026 to join Brazil's new diesel economic subsidy program created by Provisional Measure No. 1,391 (September 11, 2026) and regulated by Finance Ministry Ordinance No. 2,813 (September 16, 2026), setting R$1.00 per liter for road-use Grade A diesel over 30 days, extendable. Benefits are cumulative with the prior R$1.12/liter subsidy under MP 1,363/2026; execution awaits published regulations. This is a routine operational/policy filing, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, securities mechanics, or risk-arb angle apply.
